nina: FYI we merged the microcache-evict-saver change to canary this morning. Short story: p50 ~0, p95 -6%, p99 -20%, est token-cost -10% on mixed traffic for gpt-small-v1. :rocket:

nina: Mechanic: adaptive eviction delays for hot prefixes + a soft-evict that keeps a tiny LRU window per shard to avoid thrash during flash surges. Also tuned the eviction jitter to reduce synchronized churn.

omar: Bench numbers?

nina: Canary replay (1% sample):
```
baseline: p50 36ms p95 115ms p99 360ms cost=1.00
canary : p50 36ms p95 108ms p99 288ms cost=0.90
```

kevin: Any functional regressions?

nina: Ran unit evals and 2k prompt sims. Edge cases: some long-running streaming sessions saw slightly higher latency early on; we gated soft-evict off for streaming. No correctness issues.

devops-bot: deploy: microcache-evict-saver/v1 -> canary on pool-gpu-d (2 instances) at 2025-06-02T10:12:05Z

omar: Rollout plan and ops commands?

nina: Rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across 48h with automatic rollback on p99 regress or increased KV error rate. Commands:
```
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-d --tag microcache-evict-saver/v1 --pct 2
sleep 3600
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-d --tag microcache-evict-saver/v1 --pct 10
```

kevin: Please upload eval CSVs to bench bucket and add a console metric for "soft-evict hit rate".

nina: Uploaded to s3://ci-redwood/benchmarks/microcache-evict-saver/v1 and filed the console ticket. Dedicated will be opt-in. Closing: monitoring hooks in place, will report progress.
